source: https://scp-wiki-cn.wikidot.com/scp-cn-1109 — sampled 2026-11-22 with headless Chrome (computed styles + screenshot). Structure borrowed from the wiki's dark archive reading theme; the accent is a cold blue, not the wiki's violet.
mood: SCP 基金会档案 / 黑白为主 + 一点点冷蓝。没有任何橙色、没有任何紫色。像一份被归档的技术文档，而不是产品落地页。

type.sans: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", Verdana, Arial, system-ui, sans-serif
type.mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "Courier New", monospace

rules: Base is black and white: #121212 stage, #171717 panels, #e6e6e6 type, hairlines at 8–16% white. Nothing is coloured unless it is the one active thing.
Accent is cold blue #5b8dd6 (dim #3f6ba8), used for the current scene's marker, the active tool name, the caret and the one live readout — under ~10% of the frame. Purple and orange are both out.
If something needs emphasis without colour, use white, a hairline, or a redaction bar (#0a0a0a).

Archive grammar: mono uppercase metadata with file numbers (FILE 03 / 08), thin rules, small-caps or letter-spaced labels, black redaction bars over text, a stamp-like box for the end card. No rounded cards above 4px, no shadows, no glass.
Numbers are the ornament: let counts, dB, Hz and timings sit in mono, aligned in columns.
Motion: type-on, line-draw, counter ticks, a caret. No bounces, no glowing gradients, no particles.
One paper-coloured section (#e9e9e6 with ink #161616 and rules rgba(0,0,0,0.18)) is allowed once, like a printed document page inside the archive.
